displayIdentity.body: A community receives the message, turns, and waits. Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.
